name: Spearmint
intro: This garden uses spearmint as its mint model. Aromatic shoots spread through underground rhizomes.
observe: Look for paired, toothed leaves, square stems and small flowers clustered in spikes.
habitat: Prefers moist, well-drained soil in sun or partial shade. Dry soil does not suit it.
fact: Growing mint in a container helps limit its spread. Water according to the soil, not a fixed game timer.
